    restart: unless-stopped

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

# for imported containers to work properly
  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [
      # These are create-time-only and would force replacement if changed
      operating_system,   # template_file_id
      initialization,     # user_account.keys, hostname
      unprivileged,       # cannot change privileged/unprivileged after creation
      disk,               # cannot change storage or reduce size after creation
      features,           # API token can't modify features on privileged containers (requires root@pam)
      tags,               # tags are additionally modified via cron jobs outside of Terraform
      device_passthrough, # GPU devices may be added manually via SSH (API token can't manage these)
      console,            # console settings may be modified outside of Terraform
      start_on_boot,      # may be set outside of Terraform
      mount_point,        # mount points configured outside Terraform (API token limitations)
      # Timeout values are not actual container properties, ignore them on imported resources
      timeout_clone,
      timeout_create,
      timeout_delete,
      timeout_start,
      timeout_update,
    ]
  }
}

# Configure container features via SSH to Proxmox host
# The API token cannot set keyctl or fuse - requires root@pam
# This configures:
#   - For privileged: lxc.apparmor.profile: unconfined (required for Docker)
#   - For all containers: features: nesting, keyctl, fuse (if enabled via variables)
resource "null_resource" "configure_container_features" {
  count = (var.enable_keyctl || var.enable_fuse || !var.unprivileged) && var.proxmox_ssh_host != "" ? 1 : 0

  depends_on = [proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    unprivileged   = var.unprivileged
    enable_nesting = var.enable_nesting
    enable_keyctl  = var.enable_keyctl
    enable_fuse    = var.enable_fuse
  }

  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    connection {
      type        = "ssh"
      host        = var.proxmox_ssh_host
      user        = "root"
      private_key = file(var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path)
    }

    inline = [
      # Configure AppArmor profile for Docker support (only for privileged containers)
      var.unprivileged ? "echo 'Unprivileged container - skipping apparmor config'" : "grep -q 'lxc.apparmor.profile' /etc/pve/lxc/${var.container_id}.conf || echo 'lxc.apparmor.profile: unconfined' >> /etc/pve/lxc/${var.container_id}.conf",

      # Configure features via pct set (more reliable than direct conf editing)
      "pct set ${var.container_id} --features nesting=${var.enable_nesting ? 1 : 0},keyctl=${var.enable_keyctl ? 1 : 0},fuse=${var.enable_fuse ? 1 : 0}",

      # Restart container to apply changes and wait for it to come back up
      # The container must be rebooted for feature changes to take effect
      "if pct status ${var.container_id} | grep -q running; then pct stop ${var.container_id} && sleep 2 && pct start ${var.container_id} && echo 'Container restarted'; fi",

      # Wait for container to get an IP address after restart (up to 30 seconds)
      "echo 'Waiting for container to get IP...'",
      "for i in $(seq 1 15); do IP=$(pct exec ${var.container_id} -- ip -4 addr show eth0 2>/dev/null | grep inet | awk '{print $2}' | cut -d/ -f1); if [ -n \"$IP\" ] && [ \"$IP\" != \"pending\" ]; then echo \"Got IP: $IP\"; break; fi; sleep 2; done",

      "echo 'Container ${var.container_id} configured: nesting=${var.enable_nesting}, keyctl=${var.enable_keyctl}, fuse=${var.enable_fuse}'"
    ]
  }
}

# Wait for container to get DHCP IP
resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_ip" {
  depends_on = [
    proxmox_virtual_environment_container.lxc,
    null_resource.configure_container_features
  ]
  create_duration = "15s"
}
